whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Food Court IIT Patna,

I noticed your campus food hub has strong engagement with 705+ reviews in Bihta, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering & menu page for students.

Maine aapke food court ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme instant digital menu, popular stalls showcase, aur direct WhatsApp order/table inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/foodcourtiitp

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Food Court Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke IIT Patna food court ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha.
